items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: And so I played for Ma Rainey and that was one of my experiences, you know.

ctx.x: Mrs. Reynaud taught there. She taught there and her husband taught there, and of course she taught music also, but she taught private music, and she had classes at school, and then she taught private. Well, I was one of her private students, you know. She had many private students. She was a marvelous musician, just wonderful. And so I played for Ma Rainey and that was one of my experiences, you know.
